text: Deutsche Bank is Deutsche Bank AG, Frankfurt am Main, a listed German stock corporation whose shares are widely held. Its disclosed major shareholders under s.33 of the German Securities Trading Act are BlackRock Inc. (8.14% of voting rights), Paramount Service Holding Ltd. (4.91%) and Amundi S.A. (3.02%).
short: Deutsche Bank AG is a listed German company; largest disclosed holders are BlackRock (8.14%), Paramount Service Holding (4.91%) and Amundi (3.02%).
